D: A comfortable champion loses his edge and has to train with his old rival to win it back.
P: Serve the mains when Rocky and Apollo start training at the LA gym.
S: Rocky made it big, but he's still from Philly
Grilled bread rubbed with garlic and piled with fresh tomato, basil and olive oil. Slice a ciabatta, brush with oil and grill until charred.
training on the beach in Los Angeles
White fish in a light beer batter fried at 180C, in warm tortillas with cabbage, lime crema and salsa.
the old Los Angeles gym where Apollo started out
Chopped grilled chicken thighs marinated in chilli and lime on small corn tortillas with onion, coriander and salsa roja.
M: Chicken thighs marinated in lemon, garlic and oregano, grilled until charred, with brown rice, broccoli and a squeeze of lemon.
Adrian and the family in Philadelphia
Pork shoulder, Italian sausages and meatballs browned and simmered 3 hours in tomato sauce with garlic and basil, over rigatoni.
W: Savoiardi dipped in espresso, layered with mascarpone whipped with yolks, sugar and cream, set overnight, cocoa on top.

Fresh lemon juice, sugar syrup and cold water stirred in a big jug with bruised mint and plenty of ice.

s.note: Rocky made it big, but he's still from Philly
s.how: Slice a ciabatta, brush with oil and grill until charred. Rub with a cut garlic clove. Dice 500g ripe tomatoes and mix with basil, 3 tbsp olive oil and salt, then pile on top.

s.note: training on the beach in Los Angeles
s.how: Whisk flour with cold lager to a light batter. Dip 500g flathead strips and fry at 180C until crisp. Mix sour cream with lime juice for a crema. Fill warm corn tortillas with shredded cabbage, the fish, a spoon of crema and some fresh salsa.

m.how: Marinate 800g chicken thighs in lemon juice, crushed garlic, oregano and olive oil for an hour. Grill over high heat until charred and cooked through. Serve with steamed brown rice, broccoli florets and an extra squeeze of lemon. Fuel for a training camp.

w.how: Whisk 3 yolks with 80g sugar until pale, then fold in 250g mascarpone and 200ml whipped cream. Dip savoiardi biscuits briefly in cooled strong coffee and layer with the cream in a dish. Repeat, finish with cream, chill overnight and dust with cocoa.

d.note: the sprints on the sand with Apollo
d.how: Dissolve 150g sugar in 150ml hot water and cool. Squeeze 6 lemons into a big jug and add the syrup with 1.5L cold water. Bruise a handful of mint leaves and drop them in with plenty of ice. Stir well and pour into tall glasses.
